raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "windrose" %}
{% set version = "1.10.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/windrose-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9e1328206b9a85a80169314decd3fb2ef077bab7e0800ca9420c6c31650cf054

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-scm
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - matplotlib-base >=3
    - numpy >=1.21

test:
  imports:
    - windrose
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/python-windrose/windrose
  summary: Python Matplotlib, Numpy library to manage wind data, draw windrose (also known as a polar rose plot)
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENCE_BSD-3-Clause.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - akrherz
    - ocefpaf
